judgement.reason: LightRAG supports PostgreSQL storage backends (with pgvector) selectable by setting, so moving local storage to Postgres is a contained change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./data/rag_storage:/app/data/rag_storage (docker-compose.yml lightrag), volume ./data/inputs:/app/data/inputs (docker-compose.yml lightrag), volume ./data/prompts:/app/data/prompts (docker-compose.yml lightrag)
reviews.reason: The shown files do not include a setting that moves the RAG storage, uploaded inputs or prompts off local disk, so the default file-based storage in /app/data/rag_storage and the inputs directory remain durable state that a stateless container would lose.
